reason: A dsh plugin that uses a configured LLM agent to polish, expand, iterate, version, and optionally send prompts from the chat input interface.

summaries.zh: 在发送前调用提示词工程智能体补全、消歧、扩写并迭代优化草稿，支持版本回溯和直接应用到输入框。
summaries.en: Uses a configured prompt-engineering agent to complete, clarify, expand, and iteratively rewrite drafts before sending, with version history and direct application to the input field.

capabilities: Sends draft prompts to a configured LLM agent for rewriting
Rewrites and expands prompts using multiple iterations
Writes generated text into the chat input field
Maintains prompt version history and supports undo
Can apply a rewritten prompt and send it directly
Exposes same-origin HTTP endpoints for polishing and diagnostic logs
